blocks.html:
This method captures a payment. It sends a request to the
[Capture Payment](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#payments\_postpaymentsidcapture) API route.

The API route uses the `capturePayment` method of the payment provider associated with the payment's collection.

children.name: amount
children.description:
Custom amount to capture. If not specified, the
payment's amount is captured.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields to retrieve in the payment.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.

Learn more in the [API reference](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/store#select-fields-and-relations).
